name: cleaning-by-cassi
description: Public website and quote request service for Cleaning by Cassi.

scripts.build: node scripts/write-release.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && astro build
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.dev: node scripts/write-release.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && astro dev
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --host 127.0.0.1 --upstream-protocol http
scripts.format: prettier --write src public/*.js scripts tests .github README.md docs/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src public/*.js scripts tests .github README.md docs/*.md
